documents.title: Vacation and PTO policy
documents.content: Acme employees receive 20 days of PTO per year. Submit leave requests in Workday at least two weeks in advance for trips longer than three days.

documents.title: New hire laptop setup
documents.content: New hires receive a MacBook by day one. Enroll in MDM, sign into Okta, and request GitHub access through the IT portal.
